carrier.lab_frame: Teacher centers are fixed in the unrotated lab basis; lattice orientation rotates the lattice relative to that lab frame.
carrier.oriented_lattice_vertex: v_phi(a,b)=R_phi*(a*e1+b*e2), with phi taken from orientation_set and R_phi the exact Euclidean rotation.

digitization_convention.boundary_edges: Original triangular-lattice edges incident to exactly one included face.
digitization_convention.canonical_start: Rotate the CCW cycle so its first axial vertex label (a,b) is lexicographically minimal; if that vertex repeats in a non-simple exceptional walk, choose the lexicographically minimal full cyclic sequence.
digitization_convention.direction_word: Encode each oriented boundary edge by its axial neighbor-direction index d in [0,5] using the frozen six-neighbor list.
digitization_convention.face_inclusion: Include an elementary closed face T iff the Euclidean squared distance from its centroid g(T) to teacher center c is <= r^2. Equality is included.
digitization_convention.name: TRIANGULAR_FACE_CENTROID_DISK_OUTER_EDGE_CONTOUR_V1
digitization_convention.outer_cycle_selection: Form boundary-edge connected components. Prefer the unique simple cycle enclosing the teacher center. If topology produces more than one candidate, select the simple cycle with maximum absolute signed Euclidean area; break exact ties by lexicographically smallest canonical axial vertex sequence. Record a topology exception flag.
digitization_convention.selected_complex: Union of all included elementary triangular faces.
digitization_convention.turn_word: For consecutive directions d_i,d_{i+1}, encode signed turn as the representative of d_{i+1}-d_i mod 6 in {-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3}; when the residue is 3 use +3.

hashing_contract.serialization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sort_keys=true, indent=2, LF newlines, exactly one terminal LF

initial_axes.center_formula: c=alpha*e1+beta*e2 in the unrotated lab frame
initial_axes.design: Cartesian product radii x center_phases_lab_axial x orientation_set

purpose: Freeze a reproducible initial teacher-geometry sample design before corpus generation. The registry fixes T0 only; later teacher-data expansion is legal under versioned genealogy.

visibility_policy.initial_T0: All T0 teacher samples are visible to supervised discovery; no blind-holdout claim is attached to T0.
visibility_policy.later_data: New radii/phases/orientations may be added after inspecting errors. Each expansion creates a new teacher-registry version and is recorded in grammar/data genealogy with the exact data visible at decision time.
